skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Disciplined plan execution for implementation tasks. Use when executing a saved implementation plan, following step-by-step instructions from a plan document.
skill.summary: Execute saved implementation plans in verified batches with feedback checkpoints.
skill.author: CodingCossack

security_audit.summary: The two static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code around a referenced sub-skill name. No executable code, shell instructions, prompt injection attempt, or semantic abuse intent was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 24 uses Markdown inline code to name the finishing-a-development-branch skill in a table. It is not Ruby syntax or a shell execution instruction.
Line 59 uses Markdown inline code to reference a required sub-skill by name. There is no command invocation, user input handling, or executable code.

content.value_statement: Implementation plans can fail when agents skip reviews or tests. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through batched execution with checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Guides agents to load and critically review a saved plan before implementation.
Structures work into batches of three tasks by default.
Requires verification output before tasks are marked complete.
Prompts progress reports and feedback checkpoints between batches.
Directs agents to stop when blockers or unclear instructions appear.
Connects final completion work to the finishing-a-development-branch skill.
limitations: Requires an existing implementation plan with clear steps.
Does not define project-specific tests or verification commands.
Depends on a separate finishing-a-development-branch skill for final branch closure.
Requires human clarification when instructions are ambiguous or blocked.

use_cases.title: Implement a Planned Feature
use_cases.description: A developer can have Codex execute a stored feature plan in verified three-task batches.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Agent Checkpoints
use_cases.description: A tech lead can require progress reports and feedback pauses during AI-assisted implementation.

use_cases.title: Reduce Plan Execution Drift
use_cases.description: A code reviewer can keep Claude Code focused on the approved plan and required verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Simple Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner execution of a saved implementation plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill to implement the plan in docs/plan.md. Review it first, then complete the first batch and report verification.

prompt_templates.title: Execute with Feedback Stops
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow with checkpoints after each batch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill for this plan. Complete three tasks, show verification output, then pause for my feedback before continuing.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Risky Instructions
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan execution where the agent should question unclear steps.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill on the migration plan. Raise concerns before starting if any step is unclear, risky, or missing verification.

prompt_templates.title: Complete a Full Implementation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow from first review through development closure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the executing-plans skill to finish this implementation plan. Work in batches, verify every task, and use the required completion skill at the end.

output_examples.input: Execute the saved plan for a search filter feature.
output_examples.output: Plan reviewed with no blockers. First three tasks completed, tests passed, and the agent is ready for feedback.

output_examples.input: Continue after feedback on the previous batch.
output_examples.output: Requested changes were applied, the next batch was completed, verification passed, and the agent paused for review.

output_examples.input: The plan has an unclear database migration step.
output_examples.output: The agent stopped before implementation and asked for clarification instead of guessing through the blocker.

best_practices: Provide a plan with small tasks and explicit verification steps.
Review each batch report before asking the agent to continue.
Clarify blockers before allowing more implementation work.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation before the plan has been reviewed.
Expanding a batch beyond three tasks without a reason.
Marking work complete without verification output.

faq.question: What does this skill help agents do?
faq.answer: It helps agents execute saved implementation plans in small verified batches with feedback checkpoints.

faq.question: Does it create implementation plans?
faq.answer: No. It assumes a plan already exists and focuses on disciplined execution.

faq.question: Can it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It tells the agent to run verification commands specified by the plan or project context.

faq.question: What happens when the agent finds a blocker?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the agent to stop and ask for clarification instead of guessing.

faq.question: How large is each work batch?
faq.answer: The default batch is three tasks, followed by a report and feedback pause.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
